title: Maps: U-2 Overflights of Cuba, August–October 1962 (Missions 3086, 3088, 3089, 3093, 3095)
description: Page titled "U-2 Overflights of Cuba, August - October 1962" with two maps of Cuba, Florida, the Bahamas and the Caribbean. The top map plots Mission 3086 (5 August) and Mission 3088 (29 August); the bottom map plots Mission 3089 (5 September), Mission 3093 (26 September) and Mission 3095 (29 September), each with distinct line styles and direction arrows. Labeled locations include Havana, San Cristobal, Bay of Pigs, Santa Clara Airfield and U.S. Naval Base Guantanamo Bay; marked Secret NOFORN.
